property_summary: For any address newOwner (distinct from the admin), a call to setOwner(newOwner) by the admin must set owner to exactly newOwner; the mutant instead sets owner to msg.sender, so owner != newOwner whenever the argument differs from the caller.
change_summary: Replace `owner = _owner;` with `owner = msg.sender;` so owner is set to the caller instead of the argument.
